data.description: The Attack Helicopter is the two-seat heli you arm for fighting from the air. An attack heli costs 2250 scrap at the [Airwolf Vendor](/world/airwolf-vendor) in [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) and comes with 100 low grade fuel, burning 30 per minute. It can carry an [auto turret](/items/auto-turret), 30 flares, 36 HV rockets and 36 incendiary rockets. Shooting one down takes 2 [homing missiles](/items/homing-missile) or 2 rockets.
